读 AI 的回答时，总会同时冒出几个问题。我试着把对话分成枝条，让追问有地方放，: Reading an AI response often brings up several questions at once. I tried branching conversations so each question has a place, without losing the original thread.
做成树之后，又遇到了什么？: What happened after making it a tree?
分支多了，树本身也会成为导航负担；有些问题属于两个分支，还有些对话根本没有明确的: More branches can turn the tree into a navigation burden. Some questions belong to two branches; some conversations have no clear root. The essay explores these limitations.

在 RWTH Aachen 学习 Human-Centered Intellig: Studying Human-Centered Intelligent Systems at RWTH Aachen. Outside class, I began noticing street signs, accessibility and digital products around me.
一些观察已经写进阅读笔记，还有一些等着慢慢整理。: Some observations have made their way into reading notes. Others are still waiting to be written down.
北京邮电大学: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
在北京邮电大学学习计算机科学与技术。毕业设计涉及用 PyTorch 训练机器学习: I studied Computer Science and Technology at BUPT. My graduation project involved training machine learning models with PyTorch.
网站里也留下了 Android 动物识别应用，以及本地模型与云端识别的实现笔记。: The site includes an Android animal identification app and notes on combining local models with cloud recognition.
大学期间参与 Android 实习，也在这个阶段准备雅思和出国留学。: During university, I worked as an Android intern while preparing for IELTS and studying abroad.
安装来源追踪的文章记录了 Play Install Referrer 的接入过程: My install attribution article documents integrating Play Install Referrer and verifying campaign parameters through Google Play closed testing.
2026 年暑期，参与 AI PM 实习。: In summer 2026, I worked as an AI product management intern.
这段工作的具体内容与记录还在整理中。: Details and notes from this work are still being prepared.
探索的时候需要树；阅读的时候是线性的；记忆的时候更像图；表达的时候又回到线性。: Exploration needs a tree; reading is linear; memory is more like a graph; expression returns to a line.
当我们把记忆附着在特定的角落——那个你总是坐着的窗边、那道午后特定角度的光——当: When memories belong to a particular corner—the window you sit by, the afternoon light—where do they live if a home has no fixed form?
多个模型可能因为训练数据相似而产生表面一致。这不等于真实可靠。: Models may appear to agree because their training data is similar. Agreement does not establish reliability.
下一代产品的竞争，或许不再是“谁处理信息最快”，而是“谁能帮助人类形成更好的判断: The next generation of products may compete less on processing information quickly and more on helping people make better judgments.
